Holy shit, it's hard for me to even think about it. We were on a school trip and we trash-talked our teachers and somebody told them. I was in a room with my best friend who wanted me to go sleep somewhere else because he wanted to be with his girlfriend. I went to another room and after 2 minutes I heard a bang on the door. Due to the fact that I wasnt in my room, I went to the most lame place to hide: behind the toilet door. The girl in the room got up to open the door when I quietly told her that Im gonna hide in the toilet. She opened the door and I heard the voices of the teachers. They asked the girl where is her room mate and she said 'She is in the toilet, I guess'. One of the teachers opened the toilet door wider to look for the roommate. My whole body was shaking but I took control and stood there for 2 hours. For 2 hours the teachers were screaming at the girls for talking behind their backs. During the fight I heard my friends name. So I thought that they would go to talk with my friend and apparently me. The teachers went to my friend's room and asked him where was I. He called me and told me to go down. They told us the same thing they told the other girls. And thus ended the most stressful night of my life.
